Name: Tidewalker and Cleaner Beach
Author: DarkSylux315
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=2]YOU KNOW WHAT REALLY [b][color=#e06666]GRINDS MY GEARS[/color][/b]?
When I'm taking a nice stroll on the beach and I suddenly stub my toe on a random wood plank or smack into some invisible barrier on the far side of the beach. [i]Who even put those there!?

[/i][/size][/font][size=2]I know I'm not the only one irritated by these unnecessary obstacles.  As far as I can tell, they don't serve any purpose other than just keeping you from enjoying your scavenger hunt.[/size]


[color=#6d9eeb][b][size=3]What this mod does:[/size][/b]
[/color][color=#6d9eeb][b]
[/b][/color][list]
[*][color=#6d9eeb][size=3][b]Gives you the godlike power to walk across tide pools (and also allows your noble steed to enjoy them)[/b][/size][/color]
[/list][color=#6d9eeb][b]
[/b][/color][list]
[*][color=#6d9eeb][size=3][b]Cleans up the beach by removing several random wood planks that hinder movement in the main areas[/b][/size][/color]
[/list][color=#6d9eeb][b]
[/b][/color][list]
[*][color=#6d9eeb][size=3][b]Helps maintain immersion in the game[/b][/size][/color]
[/list][color=#6d9eeb][b]
[/b][/color][list]
[*][color=#6d9eeb][size=3][b]Bonus: Allows you to walk on top of the piles of rope on the pier[/b][/size][/color]
[/list]


[size=2]Choose the file appropriate for your version of Stardew Valley (1.2 or 1.3+).
If you have not purchased Stardew Valley[/size] legitimately, please consider doing so. It is worth [u]EVERY[/u] penny.
Click [size=2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/413150/Stardew_Valley/][u]here[/u][/url] to get it on Steam.

[/size][color=#6aa84f][size=3]Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] for easy install! Just extract the zip into your Mods folder.
Optional files are available if you don't use Content Patcher.[/size][/color]


[size=2]>> Currently incompatible with the Stardew Valley Expanded mod.  I can make a compatible version if there is enough interest.[/size]



[size=2]My other mod:[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2140][size=2]Pet Sounds for Other Mods[/size][/url]



[size=4]Enjoy![/size]

Downloads.Description:
Cleaner Beach only, no Tidewalker. Use this if you play Stardew 1.3+.
If you don't use Content Patcher just drop the xnb files into your Content/Maps folder.
